This harmful iron over load results in many complications like growth retardation, delayed sexual maturation and later on involvement of liver, heart and endocrine glands. Hepcidin controls the dietary iron absorption and release of iron from macrophages. The present study aimed to determine and compare the serum level of hepcidin in thalassemia major patients with controls. Materials and Methods: This was case control study conducted in the department of biochemistry after Ethical committee approval.
